content: [Part 1 - Picture 1] Look at the photograph of a meeting room and choose the statement that best describes what you see.

choices.label: A
choices.text: They are arranging chairs around the table.

choices.label: B
choices.text: A woman is pointing at a chart on the screen.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Some documents are being placed in a folder.

choices.label: D
choices.text: The projector is being mounted on the ceiling.

correctChoice.label: B
correctChoice.text: A woman is pointing at a chart on the screen.

explanation: Đáp án B đúng: Người phụ nữ đang chỉ vào biểu đồ trên màn hình thuyết trình.

content: [Part 1 - Picture 2] Look at the photograph of a warehouse and choose the statement that best describes what you see.

choices.label: A
choices.text: Boxes are stacked on wooden pallets.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Workers are loading a delivery truck.

choices.label: C
choices.text: A man is sweeping the warehouse floor.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Safety helmets are hanging on the wall.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Boxes are stacked on wooden pallets.

explanation: Đáp án A đúng: Các thùng hàng đang được xếp chồng lên các tấm pallet gỗ.

content: When is the client from London arriving?
explanation: Câu hỏi When (Khi nào) -> Đáp án B trả lời mốc thời gian 'Tomorrow afternoon at two o'clock'.

content: Who is responsible for ordering the new office printers?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ms. Davis from the IT department.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Ms. Davis from the IT department.

explanation: Câu hỏi Who (Ai) -> Đáp án A chỉ người phụ trách là cô Davis phòng IT.

content: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
explanation: Trong đoạn hội thoại, người phụ nữ hỏi về 'updated budget report for the marketing campaign'.

content: Why have travel expenses increased?

choices.label: C
choices.text: Employees will attend a trade show in Singapore.

choices.label: D
choices.text: A consultant was hired from abroad.

correctChoice.label: C
correctChoice.text: Employees will attend a trade show in Singapore.

explanation: Người phụ nữ giải thích: 'that's because of the upcoming trade show in Singapore next month'.

content: Where does this announcement most likely take place?
explanation: Thông báo nhắc tới 'board Flight 402 to Tokyo' và 'Gate 14B' -> tại sân bay.

content: What are passengers invited to do at Gate 14B?
explanation: 'enjoy complimentary refreshments at Gate 14B' (complimentary = free).

content: The board of directors will meet next Monday to ___ the proposed merger.
explanation: Sau 'to' chỉ mục đích cần một động từ nguyên mẫu (to V) -> chọn 'discuss'.

content: All visitors must wear a security badge ___ they are inside the research facility.
explanation: Sau chỗ trống là một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh 'they are inside...' nên cần liên từ 'while' (trong khi). 'during' và 'despite' đi với cụm danh từ.

content: Question 11 in passage: 'All full-time employees are (11) ___ to register for a time slot...'
explanation: Cấu trúc bị động 'are required to V' (được yêu cầu làm gì).

content: Question 12 in passage: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank (12).

choices.label: A
choices.text: Late registrations will not be accepted after the deadline.

choices.label: B
choices.text: The company cafeteria will be closed for renovation.

choices.label: C
choices.text: Please submit your travel receipts to accounting.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Several new interns joined the marketing team.

correctChoice.label: A
correctChoice.text: Late registrations will not be accepted after the deadline.

explanation: Câu trước nhắc hạn đăng ký là thứ Sáu 5:00 P.M., nên câu A (Đăng ký muộn sau hạn sẽ không được chấp nhận) liên kết mạch lạc nhất.

content: What will the first 50 visitors receive on Saturday?
explanation: Đoạn quảng cáo ghi rõ: 'The first 50 customers will receive a free leather notebook.'

content: How can a customer qualify for free delivery?

choices.label: A

content: [Part 5 - Câu 7] The software installation process will begin _______ as soon as you confirm your administrative password.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 8] Dr. Gomez has earned a stellar _______ as one of the leading pediatric researchers in the country.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 9] The revised budget report must be submitted to the finance board _______ Friday at 4:00 P.M.
explanation: 'no later than + thời gian' nghĩa là 'chậm nhất là vào lúc'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 10] Customer feedback cards are analyzed _______ to determine areas where service quality can be improved.
explanation: Cần phó từ 'regularly' để bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'analyzed'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 11] Please ensure that all confidential documents are _______ stored in locked cabinets overnight.
explanation: Cần phó từ 'securely' đứng trước động từ phân từ 2 'stored'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 12] Neither the design team _______ the manufacturing division had anticipated the surge in product demand.
explanation: Cặp liên từ tương hỗ 'neither ... nor ...'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 13] The newly hired administrative assistant showed great _______ in resolving the scheduling conflict.
explanation: 'show initiative' (thể hiện sự chủ động/sáng kiến) là cụm từ cố định.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 14] The board members voted _______ in favor of approving the proposed merger agreement.
explanation: Cần phó từ 'unanimously' (nhất trí đồng thuận) bổ nghĩa cho 'voted'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 15] Tickets for the international symphony orchestra concert sold out within _______ minutes of release.
explanation: 'minutes' là danh từ đếm được số nhiều, dùng 'a few'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 16] Any defective merchandise should be returned to the manufacturer _______ thirty days of purchase.
explanation: 'within + khoảng thời gian' nghĩa là 'trong vòng (30 ngày)'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 17] The warranty covers replacement components, but labor charges are the _______ of the customer.
explanation: Cần danh từ 'responsibility' sau mạo từ 'the'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 18] Because of a technical malfunction in the ventilation system, staff members were instructed to leave _______.
explanation: Cần phó từ 'promptly' (ngay lập tức) bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'leave'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 19] The CEO announced that the company's net quarterly profit has risen _______ compared to last year.
explanation: 'risen substantially' (tăng trưởng đáng kể).

content: [Part 5 - Câu 20] Applicants interested in the graphic designer vacancy should include _______ portfolio with their resume.
explanation: Cần tính từ sở hữu 'their' đứng trước danh từ 'portfolio'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 21] _______ who wish to attend the leadership development workshop must complete the registration form by noon.
explanation: 'Those who...' mang nghĩa 'Những người mà...'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 22] The inspection team found that the production line was operating _______ peak efficiency.
explanation: Cụm cố định 'at peak efficiency' (ở mức hiệu suất đỉnh điểm).

content: [Part 5 - Câu 23] Before selecting a catering vendor, please request price _______ from at least three different businesses.
explanation: 'price quotes' mang nghĩa là bảng báo giá.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 24] The construction project has progressed smoothly, _______ occasional delays caused by rainstorms.
explanation: 'notwithstanding + Noun phrase' mang nghĩa 'mặc dù'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 25] All lab personnel must wear protective eyewear _______ entering the chemical synthesis chamber.
explanation: 'when entering' (rút gọn của 'when they enter'). 'During' đi với danh từ.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 26] A comprehensive manual is provided to assist users _______ configuring the wireless network printer.
explanation: Cấu trúc 'assist somebody in doing something'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 27] The chief financial officer expressed _______ that the company would achieve its annual revenue target.
explanation: 'expressed confidence that...' (bày tỏ sự tin tưởng rằng...).

content: [Part 5 - Câu 28] Unless we receive formal confirmation from the client by 5:00 P.M., the shipment will be _______ until Monday.
explanation: Thể bị động: 'will be + V3/ed' -> 'postponed' (bị hoãn lại).

content: [Part 5 - Câu 29] Mr. Lin is widely regarded as the most _______ negotiator on the international trade team.
explanation: Cần tính từ 'skillful' đứng trước danh từ 'negotiator' trong cấu trúc so sánh nhất 'the most skillful'.

content: [Part 5 - Câu 30] Under the new corporate wellness guidelines, gym membership fees are _______ reimbursed by the firm.
explanation: Cần phó từ 'partially' (một phần) bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'reimbursed'.
